failure_rule: Negative shared-perturbation mean or a smaller difference than independent perturbations rejects the hypothesis; any budget violation invalidates the run.
gap: Probe whether an existing hypothesis survives matched budget and signal controls, including participation/subsidy accounting.
hypothesis: Mean paired pool-minus-LMSR realized proxy is nonnegative under shared perturbations and at least its independent-perturbation value on the registered synthetic tasks.
information_boundary: Only public tasks, prescribed private beliefs, training-only reservations and past permitted observations enter decisions. Realized synthetic outcomes/costs are accessed only after allocation freezes.
overlap: Simple averaging and forecast correlation effects are established. DEVIATION RESEARCH H2 already anticipates this. No new mechanism or empirical-market superiority claim.
title: Does simple pooling match the market under correlated forecast errors?
